title: contracts/harness/retro/<YYYYMMDD>.json -- one pass of the meta-harness loop
description: One pass, written by the harness seat once a day and again after each bench visit (the person's settlement of 2026-10-16, item b). It says what was read and over which window, so the next pass knows where to start and a reader can tell 'nothing happened' from 'nothing was looked at'. The tree line is copied from the validator's last line with its digest, because a bare run is nobody's commit. Counts here are read off the record and say how, under 8.3 rule 6. landed_today is the list the day's report to the person is built from, each with its revert command. If a pass after a bench visit falls on a day that already has a pass, it goes in <YYYYMMDD>-<n>.json.

bench_visit.description: For trigger bench_visit: the commit or run that records the visit.

tree.description: The validator's tree line for this pass, digest included.

source.description: What was read: a failures.jsonl, the query log, commit messages, the gate's record, the commit tool's record.

window.description: From when to when, or which commits.

found.description: What was found, with the count and the method that produced it.

measured.description: 8.3 loop step 7: for each class whose answer has landed, whether it recurred since, counted off the record.
